identificationModule.briefTitle: Safety and Efficacy of the Therapeutic Vaccine GI-5005 Combined With Pegylated Interferon Plus Ribavirin Standard of Care Therapy Versus Standard of Care Alone in Patients With Genotype 1 Chronic Hepatitis C Infection
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2 Randomized, Open Label, Multi-center, Therapeutic Trial of the Efficacy, Immunogenicity, and Safety of GI-5005; an Inactivated Recombinant Saccharomyces Cerevisiae Expressing a Hepatitis C Virus NS3-Core Fusion Protein, Combined With Pegylated Interferon Plus Ribavirin Standard of Care Therapy Versus Standard of Care Alone, and GI-5005 Salvage of Standard of Care Failures, in Patients With Genotype 1 Chronic Hepatitis C Infection

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The GI-5005 therapeutic vaccine in combination with standard of care or standard of care alone will be injected under the skin of HCV subjects. Patients will be monitored for safety, immune responses and any therapeutic benefits related to the injections including EVR, ETR, and SVR.

armGroups.description: GI-5005 monotherapy continuing on to triple therapy

interventions.name: Pegylated Interferon and Ribavirin
interventions.description: Pegylated interefron is an injection and ribavirin is an oral tablet

primaryOutcomes.description: Early Virologic Response (EVR) is a response measured by the reduction of virus in the blood after 12 weeks of treatment.
